analysis:
Only BASE text excerpts of docs/reference/configuration.md (lines 464-899) were supplied. No patch or head text was included, so the actual PR delta is not visible and no security regression can be identified from these units. The base content is documentation only, covering these areas:
- Billing, Stripe and base/Autopilot reward switches (lines 464-500). These touch TB-008 and T-060.
- Prompt sidecar and media-fetch SSRF guards (lines 510-541). These touch T-049 and TB-001.
- Provider env and config knobs: model-cache location, LaunchAgent passthrough allow-list, MiMo/Qwen4/Diffusion/Bonsai performance flags, memory budgets and hash I/O (lines 560-884).
- SSD prefix cache settings (lines 886-899).
The SSD cache section is consistent with T-041 and SEC-035 as documented: DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_SSD_TTL_SECONDS is capped at 1800 (line 899), the disk budget is half of available space with a 20 GiB fallback (line 895), and the 20 GiB write reserve is noted. Test-only controls are documented: ALLOW_EPHEMERAL, TEST_ROOT, TEST_PERSISTENT_KEY and the media-fetch ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS flags (lines 541, 896-898). These warrant review if the head changes any default, such as the TTL cap, a loosened SSRF default, or a widened LaunchAgent passthrough. A later pass should diff the head against these lines. Coverage limit: the missing patch means this is not evidence of safety.
